ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across approximately 95% of the visible surface, with high-intensity (white/off-white) clusters limited to the distal tips and transient specular highlights from water sheeting.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark pigmentation across the entire visible surface; distinct high-contrast white and beige geometric clusters localized at the extreme distal tips (left and right terminals) corresponding to biological encrustations.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical V-shaped median notch with an estimated angle of 50-60 degrees and a bounding-box depth approximately 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-frequency serrations along the primary trailing edge; high-amplitude, irregular topographic variations at the distal tips caused by dense barnacle clusters protruding from the linear boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep originating from the median notch, transitioning to a convex curve along the mid-lobe, and ending in an approximately horizontal orientation at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatially dense clusters of circular, high-contrast pixels located at the far lateral margins of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single, high-contrast vertical linear disruption on the right fluke lobe, originating near the mid-trailing edge and extending toward the anterior portion of the fluke.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustations (Coronula spp. patterns) at both fluke tips; visible vertical linear scar/scratch on the dorsal-right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant water spray and sheeting creating transient pixel noise across the central fluke surface, partially masking fine-scale dermal texture.
